materialFindings.finding: Alpha and Beta independently converge on the same directional mechanism: purpose-built AV commercialization can face a regulatory/certification throughput constraint distinct from technical autonomy capability, while rule modernization can migrate rather than eliminate the constraint.

No evidence in the immediately preceding artifacts supports applying the constraint uniformly to all autonomy names; the required next handoff is entity/architecture classification plus explicit falsifier testing.
